title: Burnham Pledges to Back Zelensky as Trump’s Ukraine Support Wavers
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky, who met with Britain’s prime minister, has said Ukraine received no warning of Russian attacks, but President Trump has said Washington is still “sharing intel.”
